citations.claim: E approach in EW yellow at step 95, start of truncated yellow
E approach still yellow at step 97, last yellow second before premature red
E approach already red at step 98 after only ~3s of yellow instead of required 5s; first violating step

counterfactual.change: Set actuated=false (fixed-time) keeping all else identical; full 5s yellow is then honored and no violation occurs.

explanation: Actuated control truncates the EW yellow: with NS queues waiting ~70s, EW green gaps out around step 94-95 and enters yellow at 95, but switches to all-red at 98 after only 3 yellow steps (95,96,97) instead of the required 5. Likely the recall/actuated switching logic counts or preempts during yellow, cutting it short to serve the long-waiting NS direction.
vision_note: Steps 95 to 97 show two yellow signals while long queues of blue vehicles wait on the vertical approaches. At step 98 all signals are red, so the yellow phase lasts only three frames before switching to all-red.
